title: Media Basket Manager
description:
ABOUT THIS GAMEMedia Basket Manager is a single-player basketball management simulation game where you take full control of a basketball club. Manage transfers, develop young prospects, create tactics, and make key decisions to build a championship-winning team.

SQUAD MANAGEMENTSign players, negotiate contracts, and develop talent with unique physical, technical, and mental attributes.

TACTICS AND LINEUPSBuild your starting lineup, assign player roles, and create tactical plays. Adjust your defense, pace, and intensity to adapt to every opponent.

SEASON SIMULATIONPlay through complete seasons with simulated matches and make decisions that influence your club's performance and long-term development.

FINANCES AND SPONSORSHIPSManage your budget, control player wages, make transfers, upgrade your facilities, and negotiate deals with up to nine sponsors.

STAFF AND YOUTH ACADEMYInvest in your coaching staff and develop your youth academy to produce the next generation of star players.

PRESS AND REPUTATIONAttend press conferences, answer journalists' questions, and keep your fans happy to improve your club's reputation.
description_short: Take control of every aspect of your club: transfers, tactics, finances, youth academy, facilities, and sponsors. Experience full seasons with real-time simulated matches, make key decisions, and lead your team to victory in the league and other competitions. Single-player game.
